response: Acme Corp, headquartered in Austin, Texas, reported total annual revenue of $54.4 million with an 18% year-over-year growth, driven by quarterly revenues of $12.3 million in Q1, $14.1 million in Q2, $11.8 million in Q3, and $16.2 million in Q4. The company, which employs 342 people, demonstrated a strong finish to the year.
